package domain

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

const (
	TeacherNextActionSchemaVersion = "student-next-action.v1"
	TeacherNextActionPolicyVersion = "student-next-action-policy.v1"
)

var (
	ErrNextBestActionDisabled         = errors.New("next best action is disabled")
	ErrNextBestActionNotReady         = errors.New("next best action is not ready")
	ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable = errors.New("next best action state is unavailable")
	ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest   = errors.New("invalid next best action request")
)

// TeacherNextAction is a transient consumer of Student's authoritative decision.
// Teacher never chooses a progression action or changes its owner provenance.
type TeacherNextAction struct {
	Schema           string                          `json:"schema"`
	PolicyVersion    string                          `json:"policy_version"`
	Status           string                          `json:"status"`
	Primary          *NextActionChoice               `json:"primary,omitempty"`
	SecondaryActions []NextActionChoice              `json:"secondary_actions"`
	ReasonCode       string                          `json:"reason_code"`
	SourceVersions   TeacherNextActionSourceVersions `json:"source_versions"`
}
type NextActionChoice struct {
	Kind   string           `json:"kind"`
	Target NextActionTarget `json:"target"`
}
type NextActionTarget struct {
	AnswerID           string `json:"answer_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID     string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	CourseID           string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID           string `json:"lesson_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID      string `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID             string `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
	PracticeRevisionID string `json:"practice_revision_id,omitempty"`
	TaskInstanceID     string `json:"task_instance_id,omitempty"`
	StepID             string `json:"step_id,omitempty"`
	MilestoneID        string `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionID       string `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionScope    string `json:"submission_scope,omitempty"`
}
type TeacherNextActionSourceVersions struct {
	ContextVersion int64  `json:"context_version"`
	PathVersion    int64  `json:"path_version"`
	RuntimeVersion string `json:"runtime_version,omitempty"`
	StateDigest    string `json:"state_digest"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherNextAction(input TeacherNextAction) (TeacherNextAction, error) {
	if input.Schema != TeacherNextActionSchemaVersion || input.PolicyVersion != TeacherNextActionPolicyVersion || input.ReasonCode == "" || len(input.ReasonCode) > 128 || input.SecondaryActions == nil || len(input.SecondaryActions) > 10 || input.SourceVersions.ContextVersion < 0 || input.SourceVersions.PathVersion < 0 || !validWorkspaceDigest(input.SourceVersions.StateDigest) || (input.SourceVersions.RuntimeVersion != "" && !validWorkspaceDigest(input.SourceVersions.RuntimeVersion)) {
		return TeacherNextAction{}, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
	}
	switch input.Status {
	case "READY":
		if input.Primary == nil {
			return TeacherNextAction{}, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
		}
	case "WAITING", "PLANNING_REQUIRED", "NO_PROGRESSION":
		if input.Primary != nil {
			return TeacherNextAction{}, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
		}
	default:
		return TeacherNextAction{}, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
	}
	if input.Primary != nil && !validNextActionChoice(*input.Primary, false) {
		return TeacherNextAction{}, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
	}
	for _, action := range input.SecondaryActions {
		if !validNextActionChoice(action, true) {
			return TeacherNextAction{}, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
		}
	}
	return input, nil
}
func validNextActionChoice(action NextActionChoice, secondary bool) bool {
	switch action.Kind {
	case "START_TASK", "CONTINUE_TASK", "RETRY_TASK", "START_PRACTICE_LEARNING", "START_LESSON", "CONTINUE_LESSON", "TAKE_QUIZ", "START_PRACTICE", "RESUME_PRACTICE", "REVIEW_VALIDATION_RESULT", "RETRY_PRACTICE", "SUBMIT_PRACTICE":
	case "ASK_TEACHER", "REVIEW_LESSON":
		if !secondary {
			return false
		}
	default:
		return false
	}
	t := action.Target
	for _, id := range []string{t.AnswerID, t.LearningPathID, t.CourseID, t.LearningPathItemID, t.LessonID, t.RequirementID, t.TaskID, t.PracticeRevisionID, t.TaskInstanceID, t.StepID, t.MilestoneID, t.SubmissionID} {
		if id != "" && !canonicalWorkspaceUUID(id) {
			return false
		}
	}
	if t.SubmissionScope != "" && t.SubmissionScope != "MILESTONE" && t.SubmissionScope != "FINAL" {
		return false
	}
	// Validate concrete public target identities, never execution state or
	// precedence. The owner remains the only action decision maker.
	switch action.Kind {
	case "START_LESSON", "CONTINUE_LESSON", "TAKE_QUIZ", "START_TASK", "CONTINUE_TASK", "RETRY_TASK":
		if t.CourseID == "" || t.LessonID == "" {
			return false
		}
		if (action.Kind == "START_TASK" || action.Kind == "CONTINUE_TASK" || action.Kind == "RETRY_TASK") && t.TaskID == "" {
			return false
		}
	case "START_PRACTICE":
		if t.PracticeRevisionID == "" || t.LearningPathID == "" {
			return false
		}
	case "START_PRACTICE_LEARNING", "RESUME_PRACTICE", "SUBMIT_PRACTICE", "REVIEW_VALIDATION_RESULT", "RETRY_PRACTICE":
		if t.TaskInstanceID == "" {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func validWorkspaceDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
	return err == nil && value == strings.ToLower(value)
}
